messages:
alex: kicking off a small canary for sable-int8 on /tools/structured — parse failures climbed to ~5.8% on onboarding samples

alex: example noisy output we keep hitting:
{"note": "low confidence"}
NOTE: uncertain about fields
{"action": "create", "ticket": 123, "meta": "done"}
-- commentary --

jess: yep — common pattern: explanatory prefix lines and trailing commentary. naive json.loads will fail when prefixes exist.

riley: quick salvage pipeline proposal (toggleable):
1) prefix-stripper: drop leading all-caps lines up to first `{`
2) balanced-brace extractor: find first top-level object (avoid naive line-per-json)
3) tolerant parse (json5-ish) -> reserialize strict JSON
4) final fallback: wrap as {"__raw": "..."} and mark as wrapped

mia: telemetry requirements: `salvage.attempted`, `salvage.method`, `salvage.success`, `salvage.confidence`, `downstream_schema_result`, `salvage.suspect` so we can slice by org/route. Also Dedicated orgs must opt-in for autoclean.

riley: gotchas: braces inside strings and truncated streams (missing closing brace). extractor must confirm parse success and validate schema before emitting as tool invocation. if repair yields JSON but schema fails, tag as `salvage.partial` and do not autopromote.

ops-bot: start-canary sable-int8 job=55921 logs: https://canary/55921 (monitoring)

jess: plan: A/B test `balanced-brace` vs `json5-pretty` for 3h, collect parse_fail_rate, salvage_attempted, salvage_success, downstream_contract_errors. keep retry budget=1 (soft-variant).

alex: follow-ups: jess (implement extractor + unit tests for braces-in-strings and truncated streams), riley (fuzz harness simulating quant-noise), mia (telemetry + opt-in toggle), i'll run AB and review metrics at 3h. :eyes:
